playwright-design.description: Development-only semantic gallery interactions, accessibility and responsive captures; no seeded data.

node-contract.description: Imported connector runtime authorization and safety contracts.

unit.description: One function or a small group, in-process, nothing external.

component.description: A coherent UI component rendered in-process, outer boundaries faked.

architecture-static.description: A codebase, build or dependency rule enforced by reading source or running the compiler. No database.

architecture-db.description: A rule about the live schema, grants or roles, asked of the real local Postgres.

database-integration.description: Domain layer and/or policies against real local Supabase (Auth, Postgres, RLS).

offline-contract.description: A provider or protocol shape checked offline from the web runtime: what an adapter sends a vendor and how it reads the reply, with fetch replaced.

python-unit.description: Python: one function or a small group.

python-component.description: Python: a command or handler with its outer HTTP/database boundary faked.

python-contract.description: Python: a provider or protocol shape, checked offline.

playwright-acceptance.description: Browser journeys against the running app and seeded demo data.

playwright-smoke.description: The smallest deployed-shaped check: app answers, login renders, a session works, the shell loads.

playwright-visual.description: Pixel baselines at desktop/tablet/phone widths for a small set of representative patterns — spacing, alignment and responsive composition, never a business rule. Never in the default run: a baseline drifts with design intent, not with correctness, and a diff here is a prompt to look, not a build failure.

provider-contract.description: A real vendor sandbox, called with credentials. Never in the default run; each test skips itself without its credentials. None exist yet.
